text: The purpose of this report is to establish the 2026 meeting schedule for the TTC Board, and its Committees as required by Section 20 of the TTC’s By-law to Govern Board Proceedings.

The TTC Board: 1. Approved the 2026 meeting dates for the TTC Board and Committees as follows: TTC Board: Tuesday, February 3, Thursday, April 16, Wednesday, June 17, Wednesday, July 22, Tuesday, December 15 Audit & Risk Management Committee: Wednesday, March 11, Wednesday, June 3 Human Resources Committee: Monday, January 19, Wednesday, May 6 Strategic Planning Committee: Monday, March 2, Tuesday, May 26 2. That the published schedule serves as notice for these meetings.
